items.description:
Futura International is a management consulting firm operating from Clubview in Centurion. The firm's main service lines are strategic foresight development, helping organisations plan for future scenarios and risks, and corporate IT, digital and cybersecurity audit and governance services, through which it reviews and strengthens clients' technology governance, digital risk controls and cybersecurity oversight.

Futura International shares its thinking with clients and the wider business community through published articles, videos and downloadable brochures covering these service areas. The consultancy builds its work around helping businesses plan for change in a structured, audit-based way, combining long-range strategic foresight work with day-to-day technology governance reviews. Clients can find more detail on the firm's approach and service offering, along with its PAIA and POPIA compliance documentation, on request from the practice.

G.E.M Boxing & Fitness is a boxing and fitness club based in Lyttelton Manor, Pretoria. The gym offers personalised training and group classes for members of varying experience levels, with coaches focused on technique, strength and conditioning. Its facilities include punching bags, speed balls, free weights and cardio machines, set up to support both boxing-specific training and general strength and conditioning work. The club describes its approach as building a welcoming, results-driven training environment, with instructors working closely with individual members as well as running group sessions.

The premises include wheelchair accessible parking. G.E.M Boxing & Fitness serves the Lyttelton Manor area of Centurion, giving local residents a dedicated space for boxing coaching alongside more conventional gym equipment for cardio and strength training.

Gaddtech (Pty) Ltd is a specialist distributor of components for fibre-optic, radio-frequency and power solutions, based at Route 21 Corporate Park in Irene, Pretoria. The company supplies products and services across several industries, including telecoms, data centres, mining, and the aerospace and defence sectors, serving clients across Southern Africa. Its product range is organised around fibre optics, radio frequency equipment, rectifiers, power solutions, and security solutions, alongside dedicated offerings for the aerospace, defence and mining markets.

For the telecoms and public sectors specifically, Gaddtech provides fibre product supply together with fibre management solutions. The company holds Level 2 B-BBEE contributor status. Gaddtech works with a network of suppliers and partners to source the components it distributes, positioning itself as a technical supplier bridging global component manufacturers and Southern African industrial, telecoms and defence-related end users.

GardenShop at Greenlyn Village Centre in Menlo Park is a garden centre stocking a wide range of plants and gardening supplies. Its plant range spans indoor plants, including floor-standing plants, small pot plants, hanging plants, flowering plants, succulents and low-light varieties, as well as outdoor plants and creepers, with a dedicated selection of pet-friendly plants for households with animals. Alongside plants, the store sells fertilisers and plant foods such as lawn and seedling feeds, garden hardware, herbs, organic products, garden and home decor, outdoor living items and gift cards.

GardenShop also shares seasonal gardening advice with customers, including tips on preparing gardens for changing weather and guidance on seasonal flowering plants. The Menlo Park branch gives local gardeners access to this full range of plants and accessories in one location within the Greenlyn Village Centre.

Gatskop Braai, Rook en Buitelewe is based at 9 Eland Street in Elandsfontein, Pretoria, selling braai products and outdoor-cooking supplies. The business crafts its own spice blends, sauces and marinades for use on the braai, alongside braai accessories such as the Frontier Carver tool. Its product range includes items like pancake mix, a pork-flavoured seasoning sold as Sappige Varkie, and a biltong-flavoured mayonnaise, sold both directly from the shop and through stockists located elsewhere in South Africa.

The shop presents itself as a destination for braai enthusiasts, from experienced braaimasters to beginners, built around its range of house-made spices, sauces and marinades for outdoor cooking. Customers can buy products in person at the Elandsfontein premises or find them through the brand's network of stockists around the country.

Genipo Construction is a South African building and civil construction company operating from Leeuwfontein, east of Pretoria. The business began as a small family operation and has since grown to take on projects for government institutions and departments as well as private-sector clients in other provinces. Its current operator previously worked for five years in the construction section of the Department of Water Affairs and Sanitation before starting the company, carrying that government and civil-works experience into the business.

Genipo Construction offers 24-hour emergency call-out services alongside its general building work, and describes itself as a professional, licensed construction provider. The company advertises affordable pricing with no hidden costs, offers discounts to senior citizens, and guarantees the work it carries out. Over time it says it has grown from a small family business into one of the larger players in its field, while continuing to serve both government and private clients.

items.description:
Globex Internet Services has operated as an internet service provider from Lyttelton in Centurion since 2001. The company is a registered ICASA Value-Added Network Service (VANS) member and has spent more than a decade supplying ADSL connectivity solutions, domain registration and hosting, and website design services to small, medium and corporate clients across South Africa.

Alongside its internet and hosting work, Globex's staff are Microsoft Certified Systems Engineers who also sell computers and accessories, repair and upgrade computers and printers, sell software, and carry out virus removal. The company describes its approach as prioritising customer service quality over simply growing client numbers, aiming to maintain consistent professional standards for every client it takes on. Globex Internet Services positions itself as a long-standing, broad-based IT services provider for Centurion-area businesses that need connectivity, hosting, web design and day-to-day computer support from a single supplier.

items.description:
Gosiame Development Consultants (Pty) Ltd is a firm of construction and property consultants that has provided professional services to the construction and property industry since 1998, operating from the CSIR Scientia campus in Brummeria. The firm's work is organised around four disciplines: quantity surveying, project management, property and asset valuation, and facilities management. It describes itself as concerned with the valuation, development, management and beneficial use of land and property, drawing on expertise in planning and development, construction, and building economics and cost control.

Gosiame's staff are professionally and technically qualified, with many years of combined experience in the construction and property sectors. Beyond its Pretoria base, the firm maintains offices in Johannesburg, Mafikeng and Pietersburg, giving it a footprint across several South African provinces for clients needing quantity surveying, valuation or facilities management services outside the capital.

items.description:
GROOTfm 90.5 is an Afrikaans-language community radio station broadcasting from Lynnwood Bridge in Lynnwood Manor, Pretoria. The station frames its mission around using the Christian faith to inspire and mobilise South Africans, aiming for what it calls entertainment that makes a difference.

Programming includes a daily breakfast show, Die GROOT Ontbyt, alongside features such as a countdown of gospel music, Gospel Top 10, and regular profile pieces on local personalities. The station also runs a blog and makes selected programming available as a podcast.

Beyond broadcasting, GROOTfm organises community-facing projects, including an annual school support initiative, a golf day, a 24-hour prayer day, and a dedicated giving week encouraging listener generosity. Listeners can also interact with the station by requesting songs or sending in messages. Through this mix of talk, music and community projects, GROOTfm positions itself as more than a music station, built around its Christian community-radio identity.

Grootman Security is a PSiRA-registered private security company (registration number 5157437) operating from the Tijger Valley area of Pretoria. The company positions itself as a fully risk-assessment-based security provider, meaning each client's security strategy, personnel deployment and pricing are determined by a tailored risk assessment rather than a standard package. Its service range covers VIP protection and bodyguarding, VIP escorts, executive protection, and armed and unarmed guarding, alongside corporate security, residential security and event security.

Grootman Security also offers strategic risk management, aiming to identify and mitigate threats proactively rather than only responding once an incident occurs. The company serves clients across South Africa from its Pretoria base, working with high-profile individuals as well as corporate and residential clients who need a security provider able to adapt protection levels, staffing and cost to the specific risk profile of each assignment.

items.description:
Guernsey Business Park North is an industrial park in the Irene node of Centurion, developed at Saltus Street within Centurion Extension 192 and positioned for easy access from the area's main arterial roads as well as the R21 highway. The park offers industrial units combining open-plan warehouse floor space with separate office segments that include a reception area, boardrooms, kitchens and ablutions. Units are fitted with three-phase power, a roller shutter door and good height to the eaves, along with ample natural light and modern finishes and fixtures.

Security at the park includes 24-hour coverage with access-controlled entrance and exit points, and the layout allows easy access for interlink trucks alongside ample open parking for tenants and visitors. Its position along the R21 gives units in the park strong visibility from the highway, which the park's developers market as a signage opportunity for tenant businesses based there.

Gym Company is a South African-owned and operated gym chain established in 1997, with a branch serving the Rietfontein and Bryntirion area of Pretoria. The gym operates on a month-to-month membership model rather than long-term contracts, and runs a loyalty programme called gym4free that lets members earn rewards such as free months for referring friends, cashback on prepaid services and gym apparel, and access to online workouts through a companion app. Membership tiers range from a virtual-only option giving access to online classes and a limited number of monthly gym visits, up to full, unrestricted access to any Gym Company branch nationwide.

The company markets itself around providing solid facilities and personal service at affordable prices rather than a high-end gym experience built on appearances. Members also have the option to freeze their membership for up to three months and bring different guests along as part of certain membership tiers.

items.description:
Henk Human Orthopaedic Services is based opposite Life Eugene Marais Hospital in Les Marais, Pretoria, and has been directed by the same practitioner since September 1994. The practice is a member of both the International Society for Prosthetics and Orthotics (ISPO) and the South African Orthotic and Prosthetic Association (SAOPA).

Its team of orthotists and prosthetists provides prosthetic services covering lower-limb, upper-limb and breast prostheses, alongside a broad range of orthotic services that include cranial helmets, cervical and spinal braces, and upper- and lower-limb orthoses. Other specialist items supplied include knee braces, orthopaedic footwear, insoles, sport orthotics and compression hosiery. The practice also supplies mobility aids such as wheelchairs and walking aids, along with home nursing equipment and other assistive devices. With roughly three decades in operation at the same Les Marais location, Henk Human Orthopaedic Services serves patients needing both prescribed orthotic devices and mobility or nursing equipment for home use.

Highpoint Rentals is a rental and property management agency operating from Rietondale, Pretoria, established in 2008 as a small rental agency that has since grown substantially. The agency focuses on building relationships with landlords and tenants, pairing its knowledge of the local property market with online tools such as a property search function and rental calculators to help clients manage and find rental properties.

Its listings cover a range of residential properties across northern Pretoria suburbs, including apartments, townhouses and family homes let on a monthly basis. The agency also provides an agent search function so prospective tenants and landlords can find a specific consultant to work with. Operating for close to two decades from its Rietondale base, Highpoint Rentals positions itself around combining personal service with practical digital tools for both landlords seeking property management and tenants searching for a home to rent in the Pretoria rental market.

Home PC Computer Shop has provided IT support and solutions from Florauna in Pretoria North since 1998, and has been an authorised Canon printer dealer since 1999. The business operates as a fully stocked computer shop alongside a dedicated repair workshop, offering laptop repairs that include screen and keyboard replacement, charger and battery repairs, driver and firmware updates, performance optimisation, and cleaning and sanitisation. It also builds custom gaming PCs, assists customers with insurance claims on damaged equipment, and runs an internet cafe with printing services on site.

For businesses, Home PC offers on-site support with call-outs both within and beyond a 20km radius, network cable installation, printer and driver installation, service-level agreements, and Wi-Fi coverage improvements, alongside remote desktop support. More specialised services cover network optimisation and deployment, data backup solutions, computer performance enhancement, network consulting for WAN and LAN environments, content filtering and hotspot solutions, and CCTV security camera installation.

ICE Tech (Pty) Ltd is a software company based in Die Hoewes, Centurion, that has focused on government digital transformation for more than 14 years. Its flagship product, the ICE Engine, is built on an open-source, low-code software architecture designed to integrate with localised systems, including payment collection, and to stay compliant as local government legislation changes over time. The platform's adaptable and configurable design allows ICE Tech to build industry-centric modules for specific, niche government operations, aiming to improve both internal organisational efficiency for government departments and the day-to-day experience of citizens interacting with government services.

ICE Tech also runs a partner programme through which other organisations can resell and implement ICE solutions with the company's support, extending the platform's reach beyond its own direct implementation work. Through this combination of a configurable core platform and a partner network, ICE Tech positions itself as a specialist supplier of digital transformation tools for government and public-sector clients.

items.description:
Infolytics Pty Ltd is a Zoho Partner consulting firm based in Die Hoewes, Centurion, serving clients in both South Africa and Zimbabwe. The company has been recognised by Zoho as a Key Business Contributor for multiple years running, and says it has completed more than 200 Zoho-related projects across over eight countries. Its services cover the full Zoho adoption cycle, from onboarding and implementation through to customisation, data migration, training, including live webinars and a training programme called The Dojo, and ongoing support once a client is live on the platform.

Infolytics also offers web design and development services alongside its core Zoho consulting work. Its Zoho expertise spans the platform's main product groups, including tools for sales and marketing, finance and accounting, HR and office administration, data and collaboration, and IT and support. By focusing specifically on the Zoho ecosystem rather than general IT consulting, Infolytics positions itself as a dedicated implementation and support partner for businesses adopting or already running on Zoho's suite of apps.

items.description:
Intersect is a compliance software platform built for accounting firms and company secretaries who need to manage CIPC obligations across their full client base, based in Midstream Estate. Rather than handling filings as one-off tasks, the platform is designed around ongoing compliance management, offering CIPC-integrated functionality for data retrieval, streamlined submissions and consistent delivery from a single system. Core features are organised around digitising records, centralising client information, automating recurring compliance workflows and enabling collaboration between firm staff and clients, including in-app signatures and segregated user access for different roles.

Intersect also integrates with the accounting platform Xero. The company positions the software as a way for accounting firms to reduce time spent chasing clients for documents and manually re-entering the same data, instead letting accountants and partners spend more time on billable client work while taking on a larger client base. New users can trial the platform free for 14 days without providing payment details before committing to a subscription.

Isaico General Dealers (Pty) Ltd is a general dealer and supplier based in Sunderland Ridge, Pretoria, established in June 2013. The company was founded with the explicit aim of empowering black youth in South Africa, both by creating job opportunities for skilled workers and by helping young people contribute to the country's economic sector for the sake of a more sustainable future. Isaico positions itself around a straightforward service promise, summed up in its tagline 'where expectation meets satisfaction,' aiming to supply quality products at competitive prices while meeting or exceeding what customers expect from a supplier.

The business operates as a general dealer, working with a range of corporate and other clients as an ongoing supplier rather than a once-off vendor, and highlights long-running relationships with regular customers who have continued using its services over several years. From its Sunderland Ridge base, the company presents itself as a youth-empowerment-driven supplier within Pretoria's general dealer and distribution sector.

items.description:
Isowall Group is an insulated panel and expanded polystyrene (EPS) manufacturer operating from a 45,000-square-metre facility in Pretoria, with more than 53 years of manufacturing experience. The company manufactures insulated sandwich panels along with EPS and expanded polypropylene (EPP) products, supplying cold-chain operators, food processors, industrial contractors, architects and specifiers across Africa. Isowall says it is currently the only FM Approved insulated panel manufacturer in South Africa, and its Pretoria facility holds ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 certification along with FSSC 22000 food-safety certification.

Beyond its core panel and EPS lines, the group's divisions include doors, windows and bending, light engineering, a drawing office, block-moulded and shape-moulded EPS and EPP products, and an interior solutions range offering decorative cornice mouldings under the Isocornice brand. The company describes its mission as building a healthy and safe working environment and a motivated team while delivering reliable, customer-focused and environmentally sustainable products, with an ambition to be Africa's preferred supplier of insulated sandwich panel, EPS and EPP products.

IT Network Recruitment and Consulting Services is a talent management firm based in Wierdapark, Centurion, that has provided recruitment, HR contingency staffing, HR consulting and administration support services across multiple sectors for more than 16 years. The company is an APSO-certified private employment agency, holds Level 1 BBBEE status, and is registered as a women-owned business. Its offering is built around three main areas: a contract management model covering the full cycle of talent management, including payroll, background checks, contracts and labour management support; a training and development division paired with a talent relationship model supporting both individual candidates and corporate clients; and a proactive sourcing approach intended to reduce the time between a client's request and an eventual placement.

The company has also been moving some of its internal processes toward cloud-based and AI- and machine-learning-driven tools, aiming to improve productivity and the quality of the resourcing it provides. IT Network positions itself around long-term client partnerships, aiming for measurable return and durable placements rather than one-off recruitment.

IT Window is a managed IT services provider based in Boardwalk Office Park in the Boardwalk Manor area of Pretoria, serving clients from small and medium enterprises up to larger corporate accounts. The company was founded with the specific aim of giving the SME sector a stronger competitive edge through outsourced IT support, built around values of integrity, community involvement and a stated commitment to continuous improvement in service quality. Its core services include managed support under service-level agreements, network support, cloud services delivered through VPS servers, cyber security, hosted Microsoft 365 services, connectivity solutions and VoIP telephony.

IT Window frames its role as handling the technical side of a client's IT environment so that staff and management can focus on running their own business rather than troubleshooting technology issues. The company also publishes IT-related articles for clients and prospective clients as part of its Tech Talk content, covering general guidance on keeping small business IT systems in good working order.

items.description:
Joel Transport is a home and office moving company based in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, that has operated since 1965. The company offers domestic moves within Gauteng that can be booked and paid for online, as well as long-distance moves elsewhere in South Africa and international moves to or from the country.

For businesses, it handles office relocations, drawing on years of experience planning and executing office furniture removals. Joel Transport also provides specialised handling for delicate or valuable items such as pianos, artwork and pets, alongside short-term and long-term storage facilities for customers who need somewhere to keep their belongings during or after a move. The company describes itself as an experienced, accredited and professional mover built up over six decades into what it calls a household name, with a large base of returning and referring clients. Customers can get a move started through an online quote process covering any of its domestic, long-distance, international, office-relocation or storage services.

Just Green Landscaping is a landscaping company based in La Montagne, Pretoria, with 22 years of experience in the industry. Its core services cover garden design and landscaping, hardscaping, irrigation systems, and ponds and water features, including koi ponds, garden dams, and both natural and formal water feature designs. The company also offers garden ornamentation, decking, paving, tree felling and plant sourcing, along with rock features and pathway construction.

Beyond installation work, Just Green provides ongoing garden maintenance and fertilising and treatment programmes, along with estate garden management for larger residential estates that need regular upkeep across common and private areas. Its work spans both residential and corporate landscaping projects, as well as interior and exterior landscaping, across the greater Gauteng area including Pretoria and Johannesburg. With over two decades in the trade, Just Green Landscaping positions itself as a full-service landscaper able to handle everything from a single water feature installation to the ongoing maintenance of an entire estate's grounds.

Just Plain IT is a managed IT provider based in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, offering outsourced IT, security and Microsoft 365 support so client businesses can focus on their own operations rather than day-to-day technology issues. The company sells an all-in-one IT package that can cover everything from supplying a new laptop through to setting up a client's website, priced through a fixed monthly IT quote rather than ad hoc billing. Its core offerings include managed IT services with unlimited support under a monthly package, hardware and software sales sourced from major brands, and cloud solutions ranging from standard Office 365 deployments to custom cloud environments.

Just Plain IT tailors some of its packages to specific industries, with dedicated solutions for law firms, healthcare providers and financial services businesses, alongside general small and medium enterprise clients. The company also publishes articles for clients on basic IT maintenance, including guidance on simple monthly checks businesses can run themselves to catch problems early.

Just Property Pretoria North is a real estate office based in Dorandia, Pretoria North, registered with the Property Practitioners Regulatory Authority (PPRA). The office works with a team of consultants to manage both landlord and tenant sides of the rental process, alongside sales listings, across northern Pretoria suburbs including Pretoria North itself, The Orchards, Karenpark, Amandasig, Theresapark and Sunnyside, as well as areas further out such as Lady Selborne.

Its listings cover a mix of property types, from two-bedroom rental apartments and duplexes to freestanding family homes, townhouses and vacant land for sale, spanning a range of price points from more affordable rentals to multi-million-rand freestanding properties. The office positions its service around dedicated local consultants who focus specifically on the Pretoria North and surrounding areas rather than operating as a generalist citywide agency, aiming to build the kind of local market knowledge that benefits both landlords letting a property and buyers or tenants searching within these specific suburbs.

Just Queue is a cloud-based queue and process management software company based in Erasmia, Pretoria, built to make service businesses' workflows visible to both staff and customers in real time. The system replaces manual tracking methods such as paper clipboards or messaging-app updates with a scan-first operator app: staff scan an item or job as it moves through each step, and the system automatically updates its status, whether that means adding it to a queue, starting the next stage, or marking it complete.

Customers can track the progress of their own item on their phone, seeing each step as it happens along with an estimated completion time, instead of having to call in to ask how much longer a job will take. On the operator side, the platform aims to replace guesswork about where an item is in a process with a timestamped, step-by-step record that managers can use to spot bottlenecks. Just Queue markets the software as a general process-visibility tool for service businesses that currently rely on informal, hard-to-track queuing methods.

items.description:
K&W Construction is an all-in-one construction contractor based in Pretoria North, serving clients across Pretoria and Centurion with over 15 years in the trade. The company's core service lines cover general construction, full building renovations, plumbing, roofing and electrical work, positioning itself as a single contractor able to handle each of these trades rather than requiring clients to coordinate separate specialists. Its projects are managed internally and supervised throughout, with the company stating it works to agreed deadlines and keeps its work compliant with relevant building regulations.

K&W Construction takes on residential, corporate and industrial projects, drawing on a team it describes as experienced field workers, and includes site cleanup as part of its project delivery rather than leaving it to the client. The company says it avoids using the cheapest available materials in favour of products and tools suited to each specific job, framing this as part of why it has sustained a long-running construction business across Pretoria and Centurion for over 15 years.

K4 Computers is an IT hardware and support business based in Laudium, Centurion, that says it has been providing service in this space for more than two decades. The company sells new and refurbished computer hardware online with nationwide delivery, covering categories such as Apple MacBook Air and Pro laptops, office desktops, notebooks, demo PCs and tablets, alongside peripherals like mice, keyboards and monitors and components such as graphics cards, processors, motherboards and memory upgrade kits. Its catalogue includes specific brands like Keychron mechanical keyboards and Antec PC cases and chassis alongside more general business and gaming-oriented hardware.

Beyond retail sales, K4 Computers offers computer repairs, upgrades and broader IT solutions for customers who need hands-on support rather than just a hardware purchase. The combination of an online store, physical repair and upgrade services, and a long operating history gives K4 Computers a position as both a hardware retailer and a repair and support provider for customers in the Centurion area and further afield through its delivery service.

Kasfin (Eiendoms) Beperk is an authorised financial services provider operating as a short-term insurance brokerage from Moregloed, Pretoria. The brokerage was established by members of the Oranjekas group to give clients a single point of contact for arranging short-term insurance, and forms part of a wider community-economic initiative known as the Oranje project.

Kasfin negotiates and places cover with a range of insurance companies, including AIG, Auto & General, CIA, One Com, Santam and Unity, giving clients access to multiple insurers through one broker rather than dealing with each insurer directly. Its product range covers personal comprehensive insurance, liability cover, engineering insurance, commercial insurance and commercial vehicle cover, as well as guarantees and watercraft insurance. The brokerage says it aims to serve clients in their own language and in a professional manner, reflecting its roots as an insurance service built specifically for the Oranjekas community before extending its offering across these broader personal and commercial insurance lines.

Khauki Construction and Transport is a 100% black women-owned company based in Ninapark, Pretoria, with more than 24 years of experience spanning both civil and general construction and transportation services. On the construction side, the company offers general contracting, design-build services and concrete services for residential, commercial and industrial projects, aiming to deliver cost-effective, quality-driven solutions that help clients control costs while growing their asset base. Its transport division runs a fleet of 23 vehicles, providing last-mile delivery, logistics management and warehousing services alongside the construction business.

The company says it has completed more than 100 projects over its history, combining its construction and transport capabilities so that clients can draw on both services from a single, long-established supplier. Khauki Construction and Transport presents its ownership structure and track record, as a black women-owned business operating for well over two decades, as part of what distinguishes it within Pretoria's construction and logistics sector.

Kimo Ice is an ice and bottled water manufacturer based in Jan Niemand Park, Pretoria, that has supplied the Gauteng market for more than two decades. The company manufactures ice cubes and ice blocks, along with dry ice and still bottled water, serving both businesses and members of the public. Its regular business customers include liquor stores, petrol station convenience stores, general food stores, restaurants and pubs, with deliveries made to retail chains such as Pick n Pay and Spar outlets as well as independent stores.

Kimo Ice also supplies ice and water for functions of varying sizes, from small private gatherings to larger events, in addition to its standing commercial deliveries. By covering both everyday commercial ice supply and ad hoc event orders, along with its dry ice and bottled water lines, Kimo Ice positions itself as a single supplier that businesses across the drinks, hospitality and retail trade can rely on for ice-related products throughout the Gauteng region.

Kwetso Consulting Services is a business consulting firm based in Sinoville, Pretoria, that has operated since 2015 helping entrepreneurs and companies register, grow and scale their businesses. Its services are built around three main areas: company registration and compliance support to get a new business legally ready to trade, branding and digital presence work aimed at improving a business's visibility, and broader operational and strategic support intended to drive sustainable growth once a business is established.

The firm positions its mission around becoming a leading business consulting partner that helps brands unlock their potential and stay competitive over the long term, while its stated vision is to bridge the gap between the challenges entrepreneurs face and the opportunities available to them, regardless of the size of the business involved. Kwetso Consulting Services frames its role as handling the compliance, branding and strategic groundwork so that business owners can concentrate on running and growing their operations rather than getting caught up in registration or compliance administration.

This distribution centre in Louwlardia, Centurion, operates as L'Oreal South Africa's logistics facility for the area, situated within an industrial precinct with a gross lettable area of roughly 15,653 square metres. The building sits in Centurion, an area that has grown substantially from what was once a town of smallholdings and open spaces south of Pretoria, with accelerating development since 1994 drawing many businesses, including distribution and logistics operations, to relocate there. The surrounding area has since built up into a more urban commercial centre, now home to shopping malls such as Centurion Mall, Mall@Reds and Forest Hill City Mall, along with entertainment venues, a theatre, golf courses and a driving range, as well as hotels including Irene Country Lodge and a number of smaller guest houses.

For L'Oreal South Africa, the Louwlardia site functions as a distribution point positioned within this broader, well-connected Centurion industrial and commercial node rather than as a standalone warehouse in an isolated location.

Lacante Henn Incorporated Attorneys is a law firm based at 35 Selati Street in Ashlea Gardens, Pretoria, with 20 years of experience in legal practice. The firm's core work covers property law, commercial law, civil litigation, deceased estates and Road Accident Fund claims, with further practice areas in conveyancing, family law, professional fiduciary services and labour law. It works with a mix of clients ranging from individuals to small, family-run companies and larger corporations, tailoring its advice to the scale and circumstances of each client.

The firm offers an initial consultation free of charge regardless of the type of case being brought to it, aiming to give prospective clients a clear sense of their options before committing to further legal work. Lacante Henn's offices keep standard weekday business hours, Monday to Friday. Over two decades in practice, the firm has built up experience across a broad span of civil, commercial and personal legal matters, positioning itself as a general practice able to handle most civil-law needs a client in the Pretoria area might have, rather than one narrow specialism.
